deployments_detail.use: Mako SmartRobotics AI-assisted surgical robots (hip/knee/spine/shoulder; Mako 4 FDA-cleared)

Mako SmartRobotics robotic-assisted joint replacement platform using CT-based 3D preoperative planning and AccuStop haptic control for hip, knee and partial knee surgery; over 1.5M procedures performed globally. [Stryker (in-house)]

care.ai SmartCare Platform: AI-driven, always-aware ambient sensors and an AI-powered Command Center enabling virtual nursing/virtual monitoring and automated clinical workflows in hospitals. [care.ai (Stryker acquisition)]

Q Guidance System with Spine Guidance 5 Software featuring Copilot: FDA 510(k)-cleared image-based surgical planning and intraoperative navigation using software algorithms to assist bone resection, pedicle preparation and screw delivery in spine surgery. [Stryker (Stryker Leibinger GmbH)]
Blueprint 3D preoperative planning software for shoulder arthroplasty using a proprietary algorithm to automate 3D reconstruction and measurement from CT scans. [Stryker (in-house)]

Mako Spine: robotic-assisted spine surgery application integrating imaging, planning and execution; entered limited market release with first cases in October 2024 and phased U.S. commercial launch. [Stryker (in-house)]
Mako Shoulder: robotic-assisted shoulder arthroplasty application, first cases completed late 2024, in limited market release through 2025. [Stryker (in-house)]
Mako 4 next-generation single robotics system integrating the fourth-generation Q Guidance System across hip, knee and spine applications; commercially available. [Stryker (in-house)]
Cranial Guidance Software on the Q Guidance System providing AI-assisted surgical planning modules and navigation for image-based cranial procedures. [Stryker (in-house)]

New 140,000+ sq-ft R&D innovation center in Bengaluru, India dedicated to robotics, artificial intelligence, digital health and product security, expanding Stryker's AI development capacity. [Stryker (in-house)]
Talent Scout AI recruiting assistant/agent embedded on Stryker's careers site that chats with candidates to help them find and apply for roles. [Stryker (careers platform)]
